title: Preflight: Agentic Last-Mile Verification for AI Software Supply Chains
abstract: arXiv:2611.31110v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software dependencies execute within the trust boundary of downstream applications, yet provenance, static analysis, and package-level behavioral approaches do not directly determine how a released artifact behaves for a specific program. We present Preflight, a program-scoped pre-execution verifier for Python dependencies that extracts application-referenced symbols, iteratively synthesizes and validates function-level harnesses, executes resolved artifacts in a restricted environment, records behavioral fingerprints, and compares target behavior against prior versions when suitable baselines exist. We evaluate Preflight on four real software-supply-chain incidents under five application contexts, a 100-package benign corpus, and a controlled function-level versus import-only ablation. Preflight returns malicious verdicts in four incident contexts and a clean verdict in the LiteLLM client context, where the affected proxy-server path is

translated_title: Preflight：面向AI软件供应链的智能体式“最后一英里”验证
translated_abstract: 软件依赖在下游应用的信任边界内执行，然而来源证明、静态分析以及包级别的行为分析方法，都无法直接确定所发布的构件对于特定程序而言究竟会如何表现。我们提出了Preflight，一个面向Python依赖的程序级预执行验证器，它提取应用程序所引用的符号，迭代地合成并验证函数级别的测试框架，在受限环境中执行解析后的构件，记录行为指纹，并在存在合适基线时将目标行为与先前版本进行比较。我们在五个应用上下文下、针对四起真实的软件供应链事件，以及一个包含100个包的良性语料库和一组受控的函数级对比仅导入级的消融实验，对Preflight进行了评估。Preflight在四个事件上下文中返回恶意判定，而在LiteLLM客户端上下文中返回无恶意判定，因为其中受影响的代理服务器路径是……
tldr: 提出了Preflight——一个程序级预执行验证器，通过提取应用引用符号、迭代合成函数级测试框架并在受限环境中运行来记录行为指纹，从而验证Python依赖对特定程序的真实行为，有效识别软件供应链攻击。
